T1.implementation_approach: Create a directory structure with folders for frontend, backend, and shared resources. Initialize version control (e.g., Git) and set up a package manager (e.g., npm, pip). Configure build tools and environment settings.
T1.notes: Ensure proper documentation and README file for the project.

T2.implementation_approach: Use a design tool (e.g., Figma) or directly code the UI using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks. Create a form with fields for title, content, and tags.
T2.notes: Focus on responsive design and user experience.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop a RESTful API endpoint to handle blog post submissions. Validate input data and save it to the database.
T3.notes: Ensure proper error handling and input validation.

T4.implementation_approach: Choose a database (e.g., MySQL, MongoDB). Define a schema for blog posts with fields like title, content, tags, and timestamps.
T4.notes: Consider indexing fields for faster queries.

T5.implementation_approach: Connect the backend API to the database using an ORM or database driver. Implement CRUD operations for blog posts.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a form for image uploads with a file input field. Add a preview feature for uploaded images.
T6.notes: Ensure the UI supports multiple file formats and sizes.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop an API endpoint to handle image uploads. Validate file type and size, then store the image in a temporary or permanent location.
T7.notes: Implement security measures to prevent malicious uploads.

T8.implementation_approach: Set up a storage solution (e.g., cloud storage or local file system). Configure access permissions and folder structure for uploaded images.

T9.implementation_approach: Integrate the backend API with the storage solution. Upload images to the storage and return the file URL.
T9.notes: Optimize for large file uploads and implement retry mechanisms.

T10.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests for the blog post creation feature. Test form validation, API endpoints, and database integration.
T10.notes: Automate tests where possible and test edge cases.

T11.implementation_approach: Write tests for the image upload functionality. Validate file type, size, and storage integration.
T11.notes: Test for security vulnerabilities like malicious file uploads.

T12.implementation_approach: Deploy the blog webpage to a hosting platform. Configure CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment.
T12.notes: Ensure proper environment variable management and monitor performance post-deployment.
